scope.purpose: Let the user pick one number in a bounded range by moving a thumb along a track.
useCases: A price ceiling in a filter, with the value shown.
A setting from 0 to 100 in steps of 5.
exclusions: Two thumbs (RangeSlider, later), vertical orientation, tick marks and labels, a tooltip over the thumb.
Readonly and invalid: a slider always holds a value within its range; show a read-only value with DataField or Progress.
A size option: one track, density through the Density modes.
alternatives: Progress to show a measure without input.

decisionsTaken: Locale is a prop (BCP 47, default "en") for the value text (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping, T2).
One thumb, horizontal, showValue at the inline end of the track (User in the Claude Code session https://claude.ai/code/session_0156c545WiY1DREDPLwwFQEf (2026-11-23), wave 6 scoping: "Slider : Ok").
Built on Bits UI Slider (type single); Page Up/Page Down, aria-valuetext and the hidden form input are added by the component (absent from bits-ui 2.19.3 slider.svelte.js), with tests.

Track in color.choice.off.*.border, range and thumb border in color.choice.on.*.surface (a selection control, like Checkbox and Switch); thumb size and track thickness are component tokens (component.slider.thumb-size 20 px, track-thickness 4 px), not affected by density.
The thumb is positioned in CSS from the value (track inset by half a thumb), never with thumbPositioning contain, which measures on the client and would be wrong before hydration.
nextAction: Contract gate (wave 6, grouped): present the contract and the token additions, record the approval.
implementationNotes: valueChange during the drag and valueCommit on release map to Bits UI onValueChange and onValueCommit; a key emits both.
